claimed_scope: Implement the smallest deterministic static pre-handoff release gate that binds an already integrity-verified final release manifest to its declared prehandoff receipt reference and validates the machine-readable installer route graph before any real clean-machine execution. Repository source/tests/CI only. No installer execution, host mutation, network/provider/VPS action, runtime/physical/effect/completion credit, or whole-system acceptance.
required_invariants: release payload identity is verified by the existing FRANKENSTEIN2_RELEASE_MANIFEST/v1 implementation rather than a second manifest authority
the exact prehandoff_receipt_ref passed to later clean-machine acceptance is already bound in the final release manifest
AI_START_HERE_DO_NOT_SCAN_REPO/01_ROUTES.json uses the admitted installer route schema and all declared file routes resolve inside the release root to regular files
state and VPS baseline laws remain exact and production_ready_condition remains PORTABLE_ONE_HANDOFF_RELEASE_GATE_ACCEPTED
static READY_FOR_REAL_HOST_HANDOFF never grants runtime, physical-host, effect, completion, or whole-system credit
the receipt is deterministic and remains outside the release payload so it can bind the final manifest hash without a self-hash cycle
next_exact_action: Implement and repository-test the static one-handoff gate; then require repository-hosted CI. Only after a final release artifact and external prehandoff receipt exist may a successor consume real clean-machine observations through the existing clean_machine_acceptance validator.
